2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000030_ALISAIE
2.description: That's good news for the Crystarium, but what of the rest of Lakeland?

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000040_ALPHINAUD
3.description: Lyna and the city guard have taken to the field.

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000050_ALPHINAUD
4.description: Thancred and the others have already joined them. Let us do the same.

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000150_CRYSTARIUMGARDYOUNG
14.description: We need only hold out a little while longer.

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000160_CRYSTARIUMGARDYOUNG
15.description: Reinforcements are coming, remember? The captain said so. We're going to be all right...

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000180_CRYSTARIUMGARDYOUNG
17.description: The Warrior of Darkness has returned. The bloody <hex:021A020203>night<hex:021A020103> has returned! So stay with me, eh? You can't go dying now!

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000190_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
18.description: Godsdammit! Please let this work, <hex:021A020203>please<hex:021A020103> let this work...

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000210_CRYSTARIUMGARDYOUNG
20.description: No! N-No, stay back! Stay back!

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000230_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
22.description: Why did you spare <hex:021A020203>me<hex:021A020103>? Why? What have I done to deserve this <hex:021A020203>mercy<hex:021A020103>!?

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000240_CRYSTARIUMGARDOLD
23.description: Forward! <hex:021A020203>Forward<hex:021A020103>! If you can still hold a sword, follow me! Wounded, to the rear!

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000250_CRYSTARIUMGARDOLD
24.description: Weapons at the ready! Let's make this count!

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000260_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
25.description: Fight and struggle. Seek salvation by your own hands.

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000270_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
26.description: Though the losses be grave, endure them. Though the victories be hollow, claim them.

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000280_LYNA
27.description: Oh. I did not see you there. Is there something you need?

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_A1_000_001_NONE_VOICE
29.description: No, no, I'm fine. How are you feeling?

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_A1_000_002_NONE_VOICE
30.description: Shouldn't you be resting? What would the guard do without their captain?

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000290_LYNA
31.description: Injuries are part and parcel of battle. While there's breath in my lungs, I shall see my duties done.

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000300_LYNA
32.description: ...Appoint another. A captain's place is with her soldiers in the field.

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000310_LYNA
33.description: Don't pretend you are not of the same mind. You fought well today. Saved a great many lives. Thank you.

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000320_LYNA
34.description: Unfortunately, this war is far from over. We must replenish our ranks and shore up our defenses before they attack again.

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000330_LYNA
35.description: Now, if you will excuse me.

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000360_LYNA
38.description: Completely...and utterly...fine! Better than fine! Hale and hearty and still alive to mourn those who are not. Who I failed to protect when they needed me most.

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000370_LYNA
39.description: We've come so far─so <hex:021A020203>godsdamned<hex:021A020103> far! I could have sworn the end was in sight. And now...

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000380_LYNA
40.description: Now they will never see it.

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000400_VAUTHRY
42.description: (-Vauthry-)The tragedy that has befallen you is of your own making. Divine retribution for your defiance.

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000410_VAUTHRY
43.description: (-Vauthry-)The heavens have bequeathed to you a benevolent savior─me! I offer you freedom from pain and suffering─a paradise where man and sin eater might live in peace and harmony...

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000420_VAUTHRY
44.description: (-Vauthry-)Why, already our winged brothers and sisters regard me and mine as kin, alike to them in beauty and purity!

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000430_VAUTHRY
45.description: (-Vauthry-)But you─you not only reject my proffered hand, but raise your own against my sin eaters. 'Tis only right that they respond in kind.

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000440_VAUTHRY
46.description: (-Vauthry-)Let this be a lesson to all those who would walk the path of sin─the wicked shall not inherit this world!

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000450_MYSTERYVOICE
47.description: My friends. With your aid we have weathered a brutal assault...

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000460_EMETSELCH
48.description: Sorry I'm late. Though I would not have been had anyone thought to notify me in advance.

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000470_MYSTERYVOICE
49.description: ...As I was saying, it was only with your aid that we weathered this assault. Without it, the Crystarium and all who dwell here would now be gone.

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000480_ALPHINAUD
50.description: For each we saved, another perished.

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000490_ALPHINAUD
51.description: If there is anything else we can do to help─anything at all─you need only ask. This is our home too, and we want nothing more than to keep it safe.

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000500_MYSTERYVOICE
52.description: Thank you. We are blessed to have you with us.

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000510_MYSTERYVOICE
53.description: As for the attack itself─Vauthry may call it divine retribution, but sin eaters are creatures of instinct. A coordinated assault is unprecedented.

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000520_MYSTERYVOICE
54.description: Moreover, in the absence of a Lightwarden, there should have been no compulsion for lesser sin eaters to congregate here en masse. All of which points to a single, unavoidable conclusion...

55.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000530_URIANGER
55.description: ...That these minions of light answer to a higher power.

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000540_URIANGER
56.description: He who did claim kinship with them─who did boast of control, not in idleness, 'twould seem, but in earnest. Lord Vauthry.

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000550_MYSTERYVOICE
57.description: Indeed. What I mistook for bluster was in fact the truth. The sin eaters are his to command. But if he imagines this show of force will convince us to bend the knee, he is sorely mistaken.

58.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000560_ALISAIE
58.description: I take it your meeting in Eulmore did <hex:021A020203>not<hex:021A020103> end well?

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000570_MYSTERYVOICE
59.description: You could say that, yes. But I am wiser for the experience, nevertheless.

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000580_MYSTERYVOICE
60.description: It appears he has mastered a technique which allows him to enslave the minds of others. A fact I discovered when he attempted to use it on me.

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000590_ALPHINAUD
61.description: That would go some way towards explaining the peculiar reverence afforded him by his subjects.

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000600_ALPHINAUD
62.description: There may feasibly be a handful of true believers among them, I suppose, but it would not surprise me if the vast majority were in his thrall.

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000610_MYSTERYVOICE
63.description: Had I not anticipated his treachery, I might well have joined them. But seeing his invitation for what it was, I sent a glamour in my stead. I rather doubt such tricks will avail me a second time, however.

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000620_ALISAIE
64.description: Did you have any luck tracking down the Lightwarden in Kholusia?

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000630_ALPHINAUD
65.description: Sadly, I have nothing to report on that front. What of Amh Araeng?

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000640_ALISAIE
66.description: After a fruitless few days scouring ruins, I resorted to asking the locals.

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000650_ALISAIE
67.description: While no one I spoke to had seen any sign of the Warden, I did uncover a possible lead: an abandoned mine in western Amh Araeng. From what the Mord told me, it would be a perfect place to stay out of sight.

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000660_ALISAIE
68.description: Of course, I could never hope to explore such a labyrinth quickly or safely on my own, so I returned here.

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000670_YSHTOLA
69.description: Even should we all join in the endeavor, an exhaustive search could take weeks─and with no guarantee of finding anything.

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000680_RYNE
70.description: The Wardens harbor vast reservoirs of primordial Light, do they not? Far beyond anything found in lesser sin eaters.

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000690_RYNE
71.description: And isn't it true that the Oracle could see the Light of a sin eater from malms away? Surely a Warden would seem like a blazing beacon by comparison?

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000700_RYNE
72.description: To the real Oracle of Light, I mean. The real Minfilia.

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000710_RYNE
73.description: If we traveled to Amh Araeng, to the south where she halted the Flood, I could summon her back.

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000740_RYNE
76.description: Don't what? Do what I can? What we both know is right!?

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000750_THANCRED
77.description: Do not presume to know my mind. You have no idea what you're proposing.

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000760_RYNE
78.description: But I do! I know why you never said anything. Because you thought you could keep me safe by keeping me in the dark.

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000770_RYNE
79.description: And...maybe I thought so too. But I knew, Thancred. I always knew!

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000780_EMETSELCH
80.description: Oh, I see... I thought you were a rather underwhelming reincarnation, but it all makes sense now.

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000790_EMETSELCH
81.description: The Oracle lies dormant within you, doesn't she? But to draw on her true power, you must become one, both body and soul.

82.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000800_EMETSELCH
82.description: To wit, one being must consume the other. Who shall be the lucky winner?

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000820_EMETSELCH
84.description: But it plainly concerns you. Which is why your heart is ready to burst out of your chest.

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000830_EMETSELCH
85.description: Despite the raging tempest in your bosom, however, you have never once opened up to your young charge. Now why would that be?

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000850_EMETSELCH
87.description: Well, I for one think it's a marvelous idea. Certainly more promising than any of your other suggestions.

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000860_EMETSELCH
88.description: So─it's off to Amh Araeng we go!

89.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000870_THANCRED
89.description: I'll meet you at the gates.

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000880_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
90.description: Take comfort in the bonds you share. Accept the pain when the time comes to part.

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000890_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
91.description: Press on, for joy and sorrow walk hand in hand.

92.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000900_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
92.description: Beyond Mount Garik lie the Hills of Amber, beneath which run hidden veins of mineral wealth.

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000910_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
93.description: Or <hex:021A020203>ran<hex:021A020103>, at least. Mayhap they are spent. Or mayhap the ringing of hammers <hex:021A020203>can<hex:021A020103> yet be heard below...

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000920_THAFFE
94.description: Magnus's wife was a miner, you know. Greatest prospector there ever was.

95.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000930_THAFFE
95.description: When the golem hearts started failing, she was the first to head out in search of more.

96.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000940_THAFFE
96.description: Problem was, most of the veins ran dry ages ago, and finding fresh ones to tap's only gotten harder.

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000950_THAFFE
97.description: But she wasn't one to be deterred. She just kept digging deeper and deeper. And then the mine collapsed.

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000960_THAFFE
98.description: We labored day and night to clear away the rubble, but it took us two months to find her...

100.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000980_THAFFE
100.description: Magnus has never been the same since.

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_000990_THANCRED
101.description: Where is he, if you don't mind my asking?

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001000_THAFFE
102.description: Ah, yes, well...if he's not here, there's only one other place he'd be.

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001020_MAGNUS
104.description: How many times must I tell you─the trolley won't run! We'd be better off dismantling the damn thing and selling the parts for scrap.

105.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001030_MAGNUS
105.description: Now piss off back to wherever you came from, and don't let me catch you around here again.

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001050_MAGNUS
107.description: My son was named Skuli. My wife, Agna.

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001060_MAGNUS
108.description: Being here with them...it beats going home. Home stopped being home when I lost them.

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001070_MAGNUS
109.description: I thought to try and drown my sorrows...but somehow...the bottle's never deep enough.

110.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001080_THANCRED
110.description: No bottle is. Believe me─I know.

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001100_THANCRED
112.description: Not like you. Not my own flesh and blood.

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001110_THANCRED
113.description: I grew up an orphan, so I never really knew what family meant.

114.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001120_THANCRED
114.description: Not until I met a man who offered to take me in and make me his pupil. He was a kindly soul. Always looking out for me, like a father. Not that I appreciated that at the time, or anything else for that matter...

115.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001130_THANCRED
115.description: But I finally had a family. And then...and then I robbed a young girl of hers.

116.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001140_THANCRED
116.description: I did my best to make amends, to offer her comfort. But the more I look back on it, the more I realize just how inadequate my efforts were. I let her down.

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001150_THANCRED
117.description: That is why I refuse to let her legacy die.

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001160_THANCRED
118.description: In the end, all we can do is press on. For those we have lost. For those we can yet save.

119.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001170_THANCRED
119.description: And that requires your Talos. Please, Magnus. You are our only hope of reaching Nabaath Areng.

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001190_RYNE
121.description: She's not gone. No matter what you say or believe, she's not.

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001200_RYNE
122.description: We can still bring her back.

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001210_THANCRED
123.description: You may not remember this about our Minfilia...

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001220_THANCRED
124.description: But prior to founding the Path of the Twelve, long before the Scions, she was something of a miner.

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001230_THANCRED
125.description: After her father died, F'lhaminn took her in and taught her the trade.

126.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001240_THANCRED
126.description: I think they were both seeking to fill the void left by a loved one. Maybe that's why she took to it so readily.

127.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001250_THANCRED
127.description: Back in those days, I spent most of my time in the Quicksand or some other tavern, loosening tongues and gathering secrets. Occasionally, I'd catch a glimpse of her in the street, on her way home after another hard day's work.

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001260_THANCRED
128.description: I always felt a wave of relief when I saw she'd come back safe...along with a pang of guilt at the fact I wasn't there to support her as I should've been.

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001270_THANCRED
129.description: Simply speaking with her more than once in a blue moon would've been a good start, but I could never bring myself to do it. Instead, I threw myself into my “work” and became every drunkard's best friend.

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_A2_000_001_NONE_VOICE
131.description: I can't imagine she thought too highly of you back then.

132.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_A2_000_002_NONE_VOICE
132.description: Not your finest hour, to say the least.

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001280_THANCRED
133.description: Not too highly, no. She once called me a “wine-sodden wharf rat”─which wouldn't have been half as galling had it not been so accurate.

134.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001290_THANCRED
134.description: Far from it─and F'lhaminn has never let me live it down.

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001300_THANCRED
135.description: But that was a lifetime ago. Here and now I have another chance to do things right, and I will <hex:021A020203>not<hex:021A020103> squander it again.

136.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001310_GUTHJON
136.description: Hey! Come and see what I've found! You're not going to believe this!

138.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001330_GUTHJON
138.description: It is, at that! You lot were born lucky.

139.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001340_GUTHJON
139.description: It's mostly broken pieces─but look at this!

140.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001350_THANCRED
140.description: This is a rather fine specimen.

141.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001360_GUTHJON
141.description: It's been decades since we've found anything approaching this big! But that's not all─there's an engraving on it.

142.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001370_THANCRED
142.description: Ah, these scratches here? They're a little hard to make out.

144.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001390_GUTHJON
144.description: Yes! Do you see!? It was a gift to Magnus from his wife!

145.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001400_GUTHJON
145.description: She found it. She <hex:021A020203>really<hex:021A020103> found it.

146.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001410_GUTHJON
146.description: She must've spent her final hours carving this message into the stone, in the hope that he might see it one day.

147.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001420_GUTHJON
147.description: Those rock-backed bastards must've made off with it before we could clear a path to her.

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001430_GUTHJON
148.description: It's fate that brought you here to find this stone. No other explanation. Makes me wonder what else might still be buried in these parts.

149.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001440_URIANGER
149.description: Preparations for the enchantment are complete. When the heart hath been suffused with a sufficient quantity of aether, the golem should be restored to life.

150.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001450_THAFFE
150.description: All right then. Whenever you're ready.

153.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001480_MAGNUS
153.description: You left me for this...this wretched heap of stone and rubble...

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001490_MAGNUS
154.description: This worthless pile of earth. And yet...I can't... I can't...

156.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001510_RYNE
156.description: I shouldn't be here. I don't deserve to be. I don't deserve any of the things you've done for me!

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001520_RYNE
157.description: I'm just a burden, helpless and hopeless. If tomorrow came and I was gone, it would be better for everyone!

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001530_RYNE
158.description: Thancred most of all. He'll never admit it, but I can see it in his eyes...

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001540_RYNE
159.description: I wish he'd just say it─just say that he hates me! That he wishes I was dead so that she could return...

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001550_URIANGER
160.description: None of this is thy doing, child.

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001560_URIANGER
161.description: 'Twas <hex:021A020203>I<hex:021A020103> who set the Oracle on her path unto the First. <hex:021A020203>I<hex:021A020103> who condemned you all to suffer these torments. 'Tis my sin alone, and one that will haunt me unto my dying day.

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001570_URIANGER
162.description: Yet I dare not dwell overlong on my many regrets, for the world is a tapestry of fates, interwoven and inseparable, and we who strive to better it cannot choose but make difficult decisions. For naught of worth was ever achieved without sacrifice.

163.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001580_URIANGER
163.description: And thus must man ever struggle to weigh life against loss.

164.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001590_URIANGER
164.description: The one for whom thou mournest beareth no grudge.

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001600_URIANGER
165.description: Were she here, she would not suffer thee to languish in sorrow. She would tell thee to seek thine own path, thine own purpose.

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001610_URIANGER
166.description: It is a truth which I myself was slow to learn. Yet a truth it remaineth.

167.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001620_URIANGER
167.description: Thou needst but have faith. Have faith and all will be well.

170.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_A3_000_002_NONE_VOICE
170.description: Have you no words for her?

173.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001640_MYSTERYVOICE
173.description: To what do I owe the pleasure that is your extended stay?

174.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001650_EMETSELCH
174.description: Oh, to the tediousness of our heroes' present endeavors.

175.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001660_EMETSELCH
175.description: That, and the insufferable abundance of Light in Amh Araeng. I should be glad to keep my distance.

176.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001670_EMETSELCH
176.description: I'm rather fond of sleep, you know. Wonderful way to pass the time.

177.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001680_EMETSELCH
177.description: Not that my compeers would agree, mind you. Always on the move, the lot of them. Like Lahabrea, constantly jumping from vessel to vessel.

178.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001690_EMETSELCH
178.description: Such fire, such determination! So much passion, fleeting and forgotten...

179.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001700_EMETSELCH
179.description: Come to think of it, Exarch, I don't believe I've ever seen <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103> retire to your chambers for so much as forty winks. However do you keep your eyes from closing?

180.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001710_EMETSELCH
180.description: The cold shoulder. You wound me, sir.

181.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001720_EMETSELCH
181.description: Always so guarded in our every interaction─interactions you curiously refrain from sharing with the Scions and their champion...

182.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001730_MYSTERYVOICE
182.description: And risk souring your budding relationship? I think not. Much as I dislike you, there are more useful targets for his energies. And I am not in the habit of pointing him at my enemies like a weapon.

183.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001740_MYSTERYVOICE
183.description: And risk souring your budding relationship? I think not. Much as I dislike you, there are more useful targets for her energies. And I am not in the habit of pointing her at my enemies like a weapon.

184.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001750_EMETSELCH
184.description: Is that right? Fond of <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03>, are you?

185.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001760_EMETSELCH
185.description: You continue to fascinate me, Exarch.

186.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001761_EMETSELCH
186.description: But tell me: who are you?

187.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001770_EMETSELCH
187.description: The once-great nation whose ingenuity gave birth to this tower was shaped by my hand. As such, I know full well the wonders it can facilitate...and those it cannot.

188.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001780_EMETSELCH
188.description: There is nothing in these walls which could have aided you in summoning our dear friend across time and space.

189.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001790_EMETSELCH
189.description: Much less in possession of <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> mortal flesh! Not even <hex:021A020203>I<hex:021A020103> could have performed such a feat.

190.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001800_MYSTERYVOICE
190.description: I see... You had a hand in Allag as well.

191.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001810_MYSTERYVOICE
191.description: You would know what I am?

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001820_MYSTERYVOICE
192.description: I am the adjudicator of the sacred history with which you dared trifle.

193.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001830_MYSTERYVOICE
193.description: I am keeper of this tower's boundless wisdom. The wisdom of ages without age. Of everywhere and nowhere. The great work of those who tamed the wings of time, and grasped the nature of the rift.

194.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001840_MYSTERYVOICE
194.description: 'Tis a boon born of the sacrifice of brave heroes who gave their lives for a brighter future.

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001850_MYSTERYVOICE
195.description: 'Tis a boon born of sacrifices yet unmade... The parting gift of brave heroes who will one day give their lives for a brighter future.

196.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001860_MYSTERYVOICE
196.description: I will not see their hopes and dreams squandered. The history which led us here <hex:021A020203>will<hex:021A020103> be unwritten. I promise you that.

197.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001870_EMETSELCH
197.description: Well, it seems we are both eager to fulfill our duties, then.

198.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001880_MYSTERYVOICE
198.description: On that much we are in agreement.

200.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001900_URIANGER
200.description: Thou must needs carry on without me.

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001910_URIANGER
201.description: The path to Nabaath Areng lieth open. Whilst thou travelest thither to the south, I would apprise Mistress Alisaie and the others of our progress.

202.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001920_URIANGER
202.description: As circumstances permit, I will thereafter rejoin the hunt for the remaining Lightwardens.

203.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001930_THANCRED
203.description: Magnus. Will the gate close immediately after the trolley passes through?

204.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001940_MAGNUS
204.description: No, it will stay open until someone closes it manually. Built that way to prevent any untimely accidents.

205.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001950_THANCRED
205.description: Then you and the others can meet us in Nabaath Areng after giving the Eulmorans the slip.

208.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001980_URIANGER
208.description: Remember: thou needst but have faith.

209.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_001990_MAGNUS
209.description: If you've finished with your good-byes, I suggest you grab hold of something. Be a shame if you took a tumble.

210.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002000_MAGNUS
210.description: The tracks beyond the gate aren't in the best of shape, so the trolley can only go as far as Amh Malik.

212.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002020_THANCRED
212.description: Ah, that must be the gate.

218.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002080_THANCRED
218.description: You're a stubborn old swine, aren't you...

219.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002090_RANJIT
219.description: One who has mastered Gukumatz fears not the blackest pit or the fieriest hell.

220.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002100_RANJIT
220.description: Your deeds in the east did not go unnoticed. Long have I lain in wait, and sure enough, you did not disappoint.

221.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002110_RANJIT
221.description: Had you only sworn fealty to Lord Vauthry, you would have no cause to skulk about like frightened animals.

223.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002130_RANJIT
223.description: You will remain as you are, while I dispatch these villains.

224.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002140_RYNE
224.description: No! I won't...! I won't let you!

225.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002150_RANJIT
225.description: You forget to whom you speak! Who armed you? Trained you? Fought and killed a thousand sin eaters with you!?

226.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002160_RANJIT
226.description: And when you were inevitably cut down and lay lifeless in my arms─who sought out your successor to carry on the futile struggle again and again!?

227.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002170_RANJIT
227.description: We seek to bring peace to what is left of this shattered land, while these mad fools would only bring further chaos down upon us!

228.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002180_RANJIT
228.description: Do not be deceived, child! Only by Lord Vauthry's hand will this dying world know a sliver of salvation!

229.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002190_RYNE
229.description: I don't know about the world...but I never asked to be saved.

230.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002200_RYNE
230.description: However much it hurts, and however hard it gets, it's my life, and I want to live it on my own terms!

231.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002210_RYNE
231.description: And those “mad fools” you want me to abandon? The ones I've traveled with, fought with, and may one day die with─they feel the same.

232.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002220_RYNE
232.description: So no, I will <hex:021A020203>not<hex:021A020103> be deceived! No matter what you say, I refuse to believe it's all for nothing!

233.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002230_RYNE
233.description: They're everything to me. All I have and all I need. And I would gladly do anything for them.

234.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002240_RYNE
234.description: Let us pass, or kill me. I'm not leaving here without them.

235.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002250_RANJIT
235.description: How <hex:021A020203>dare<hex:021A020103> you! Very well─if you would cast your lot with villains, then you shall share their fate!

237.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002260_THANCRED
237.description: I heard what you said. And I'm sorry for all the things I've left unspoken.

240.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002290_THANCRED
240.description: Go! Do what you came here to do.

241.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002300_THANCRED
241.description: I'll not have you waste that newfound resolve on me.

242.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002310_THANCRED
242.description: I leave her in your hands. Hurry!

243.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002320_THANCRED
243.description: Not another step! Your fight is with me.

244.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002330_RANJIT
244.description: You think yourself her protector!? Hah! As if a whelp like you could be a better father to her than me!

245.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002340_RANJIT
245.description: You would have her suffer and die. I would spare her that fate!

246.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002350_THANCRED
246.description: That is not for you or anyone else to decide─ever again.

248.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002370_THANCRED
248.description: Not a single day goes by that I don't think about all that you have given me.

249.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002380_THANCRED
249.description: Countless memories and moments I took for granted... Gods, you grew up so fast.

250.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002390_THANCRED
250.description: But you had to, didn't you? For those you had lost. For those you could yet save.

251.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002400_THANCRED
251.description: A world teetering on the very brink of oblivion, for which you gave your everything without hesitation...

252.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002410_THANCRED
252.description: Your kindness, your compassion, your love... Then and now...

253.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002420_THANCRED
253.description: One last time, with a little help. I'm so proud to have been a part of your life...

256.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002450_NABAATHARENGPEOPLEA
256.description: Run for your lives! It's the Flood! The Flood!

259.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002480_NABAATHARENGPEOPLED
259.description: Look! Th-There's somebody up there! On top of the palace!

263.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002520_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
263.description: But this is what I want! It's my sacrifice to make!

264.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002530_MINFILIA
264.description: Your time has not yet come.

265.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002540_MINFILIA
265.description: When all hangs in the balance, <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103> must give them hope.

269.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002580_MINFILIA
269.description: Ours is a meeting long overdue. Full glad am I that we may finally speak.

271.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_A4_000_001_NONE_VOICE
271.description: It's good to see you again.

274.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002590_MINFILIA
274.description: My dear, sweet child... Yours is a burden none should ever be forced to bear.

275.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002600_MINFILIA
275.description: Such pain and suffering you have endured, yet still you came. For this and more, I thank you.

276.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002610_RYNE
276.description: I've lost count of the times I've almost given up. If people hadn't helped me every step of the way, I never would have made it.

277.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002620_MINFILIA
277.description: Yet here you stand, resolved. Now...tell me your heart's desire.

278.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002630_RYNE
278.description: To defeat the sin eaters, and bring this world back from the brink!

279.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002640_RYNE
279.description: The remaining Wardens have hidden themselves from us. But with the power of the Oracle, I thought we might be able to find them...

280.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002650_MINFILIA
280.description: Indeed you could. Their radiance would be unmistakable.

281.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002660_MINFILIA
281.description: But know, my child, that the power you seek will come at a price.

282.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002670_MINFILIA
282.description: We stand now at the crossroads. A decision must be made.

283.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002680_MINFILIA
283.description: 'Tis only natural to be afraid. To hesitate.

284.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002690_MINFILIA
284.description: But for your many trials, you have grown stronger and wiser. And with the love and support of those you hold dear, you have grown to love yourself.

285.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002700_RYNE
285.description: The Flood has washed away so much of this world.

286.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002710_RYNE
286.description: So many people and places and possibilities─and all the heroes who fought to protect them.

287.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002720_RYNE
287.description: Yet here the Scions are, trying so, so hard to help those few of us who remain. And seeing how tirelessly they work, how completely committed they are to the cause...I can't help but believe.

288.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002730_RYNE
288.description: But I want to do more than just watch and cheer. I want to make a difference.

289.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002740_RYNE
289.description: I want to help them, like they helped me─and maybe even inspire others to do the same.

290.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002750_RYNE
290.description: Coming together, providing for one another─that's the only way forward I can see. Since all of our heroes are gone, we'll just have to make heroes of ourselves.

291.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002760_MINFILIA
291.description: 'Tis a beautiful, wonderful dream. One we share.

292.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002770_MINFILIA
292.description: Though my power was all but spent in staying the Flood, I prayed this final act would give hope to those who survived.

293.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002780_MINFILIA
293.description: That selfsame hope lives on in you. It gives me comfort to know that the future is in capable hands.

294.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002790_MINFILIA
294.description: If ever you should falter, remember this: no one, however powerful, is immune to the whisperings of doubt and despair.

295.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002800_MINFILIA
295.description: Do not give in to them, but do not deny them either. Look instead to the light within, that you may continue to serve as a beacon to others.

296.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002810_RYNE
296.description: Thank you, Minfilia, for believing in us. For believing in me.

297.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002820_MINFILIA
297.description: Dearest friend...no words can express my gratitude to you for keeping her safe in these tumultuous times. You are a hero to us both.

298.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002830_MINFILIA
298.description: But not even the most valiant heroes can stand alone.

299.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002840_MINFILIA
299.description: Only <hex:021A020203>together<hex:021A020103> may you change the fate of two worlds.

300.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002850_THANCRED
300.description: Ah, there you are. We were worried.

301.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002860_ALISAIE
301.description: Really? <hex:02080CE905FF04536865FF03486503> wasn't the one that nearly got <hex:020815E905FF0868657273656C66FF0868696D73656C6603> killed.

302.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002870_ALISAIE
302.description: It's a good thing Urianger called on us when he did. You were at death's door when we found you.

303.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002880_THANCRED
303.description: But thanks to your timely ministrations, I was not obliged to walk through it.

306.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002910_RYNE
306.description: (-Minfilia-)I know I haven't exactly been pulling my weight up till now, but that's all going to change, starting today.

307.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002920_RYNE
307.description: (-Minfilia-)I'll do whatever it takes─whatever it takes to make Minfilia's dream a reality.

308.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002930_RYNE
308.description: (-Minfilia-)I can track the Lightwardens now. Maybe even help you fight them.

310.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002950_RYNE
310.description: (-Minfilia-)You don't have to say that, you know...

311.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002960_THANCRED
311.description: But I want to. You're family. How else would I feel?

314.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_002990_YSHTOLA
314.description: A name of her own. I would not have her walk in the shadow of another any longer.

315.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_003000_YSHTOLA
315.description: And I think it a fitting tribute to our departed friend too. At the mention of Minfilia, I would remember the woman who preserved our fellowship when all seemed lost.

316.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_003010_ALISAIE
316.description: Do you remember what you were called before you were taken to Eulmore?

317.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_003020_RYNE
317.description: (-Minfilia-)I'm sorry, I don't. I couldn't have been very old when it happened.

318.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_003030_YSHTOLA
318.description: Then we must think of a new name. Suggestions?

319.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_003040_ALPHINAUD
319.description: If the lady herself has no preference, I think the honor should rightly fall to Thancred. After all they have been through together, he's practically a father to her.

320.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_003050_ALISAIE
320.description: Well spotted! I'm so glad you're here to explain these things.

321.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_003060_ALPHINAUD
321.description: And what exactly is that supposed to mean?

325.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_003100_URIANGER
325.description: Wait! Doth this mean thou wert <hex:021A020203>listening<hex:021A020103> when I delivered my lectures on the pixies?

326.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_003110_THANCRED
326.description: Not exactly. But that one word made an impression.

327.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_003120_THANCRED
327.description: Of course, if it's not to your liking, I can think of something else.

328.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_003130_RYNE
328.description: Ryne... Yes, I rather like the sound of it.

330.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_003150_THANCRED
330.description: That settles it, then. Welcome aboard, Ryne!

332.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_003170_THAFFE
332.description: Don't get me wrong, I'm glad those travelers made it all the way to Nabaath Areng...

333.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_003180_THAFFE
333.description: But when Urianger told me the Talos was in pieces, and the trolley didn't look much better, I couldn't help wondering what in the hells had gone on.

334.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_003190_MAGNUS
334.description: What indeed. At least the heart is in one piece. The rest is replaceable.

335.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_003200_MAGNUS
335.description: Looking at this mess, though, it's a miracle they survived...

336.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_003210_THAFFE
336.description: Heh, you can say that again.

337.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_003220_THAFFE
337.description: Wha─ What the!? Are you seeing this!?

339.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_003240_ALISAIE
339.description: At last. Night has returned to Amh Araeng.

340.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_003250_ALISAIE
340.description: We'll save this broken world yet, Tesleen. You see if we don't...

341.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_003260_ALPHINAUD
341.description: No doubt retreating in the wake of the Warden's demise.

342.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_003270_YSHTOLA
342.description: Back to Kholusia. The last refuge of Light.

343.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_003280_THANCRED
343.description: Home to our dear Lord Vauthry─who will no doubt do everything in his power to thwart us.

344.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_003290_ALPHINAUD
344.description: As well he should, for defeat there would spell the end for both him and his heavenly host.

345.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_003300_ALPHINAUD
345.description: There the fate of this star shall be decided.

347.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_A5_000_001_NONE_VOICE
347.description: So this is where you've been hiding.

349.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_003310_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
349.description: Sometimes the dead would rather not be disturbed. But enough about me─what of Amh Araeng?

351.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_003330_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
351.description: Which means the reason I must suffer this purgatory shall forever remain a mystery.

352.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_003340_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
352.description: What's the matter? Are you all right?

356.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_A6_000_001_NONE_VOICE
356.description: There...there was something Minfilia said to me...

357.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_A6_000_002_NONE_VOICE
357.description: Not even the most valiant heroes can stand alone...

358.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_003370_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
358.description: Minfilia said my time had not yet come. That I still had a role to play.

359.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_003380_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
359.description: Not even the most valiant heroes can stand alone...

360.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_003390_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
360.description: No─ No, it couldn't be. There's only one hero in this room, and it is <hex:021A020203>not<hex:021A020103> me. I'm just a shadow, cursed to wander.

361.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_003400_MYSTERYVOICE
361.description: Ahem. Forgive the intrusion, but Minfilia─that is, Ryne and the others were asking after you.

363.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_003420_MYSTERYVOICE
363.description: That pain again? And did it pass?

364.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_003430_MYSTERYVOICE
364.description: Thank goodness for that. I would not wish to see you suffer.

365.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_003440_MYSTERYVOICE
365.description: Though I know only too well how much you have suffered on our behalf in recent days.

366.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_003450_MYSTERYVOICE
366.description: Indeed, I have no right to impose upon you further. Nevertheless, I must ask one thing of you.

367.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_003460_MYSTERYVOICE
367.description: That you survive this, no matter what.

368.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_003470_MYSTERYVOICE
368.description: When the dust settles, you <hex:021A020203>must<hex:021A020103> return to your world. For the battles to come and the wars yet unwon.

369.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_003480_MYSTERYVOICE
369.description: The final Lightwarden is all that stands between us and victory. There is still much we must do to prepare, but for now, I will see if there is aught that may remedy the strange affliction which plagues you.

372.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_A7_000_002_NONE_VOICE
372.description: The end is finally in sight.

373.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_A7_000_003_NONE_VOICE
373.description: When the Warden is dead, will your work finally be done?

374.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_003490_MYSTERYVOICE
374.description: Of that I have no doubt. Even if I had my pick of every reflection's heroes, I could not have asked for a finer champion.

375.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_003500_MYSTERYVOICE
375.description: Indeed it is. But for now put all such concerns from your mind.

376.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_003510_MYSTERYVOICE
376.description: Yes, I believe it will. Once the tyranny of light is ended, the people of the Crystarium will be safe, and the future that must be shall come to pass.

377.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05003_003520_MYSTERYVOICE
377.description: I'll not keep you from your rest any longer. Take as much time as you like.
